qwen3_4b_base.note: the revision s8_ei used (docs/fiorillo_v0_4.md), and the repository's current revision when read

tabicl.license: BSD-3-Clause (the wheel's tabicl-2.2.0.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE; the code under src/tabicl/forecast, derived from TabPFN-TS, is Apache-2.0 and is not used)

checkpoint.license: bsd-3-clause (the card's metadata; the card states no other terms)
checkpoint.load: download with huggingface_hub.hf_hub_download(repo_id='jingang/TabICL', filename='tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt', revision=<this revision>), check its SHA-256, and pass its path as model_path with allow_auto_download=False, so that no other revision is fetched

documentation.inputs: pandas DataFrames or numpy arrays; categorical columns (string, object, category and boolean types) are detected and ordinal-encoded, with a separate category for missing values; missing numerical values (NaN) are mean-imputed
documentation.context: the README reports strong results with 300 to 100,000 training samples and up to 2,000 features, and larger sets (for example 500,000 samples) through CPU and disk offloading; it sets no largest context below the 55,978 training records, so the whole training split is the context (THE READMISSION POOL, VERSION 2)

biogpt_large_pubmedqa.license: mit (the card's metadata; the repository holds no license file)
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.tokenizer: BioGptTokenizer at the same revision (Moses tokenization through sacremoses, then BPE); it puts </s> (id 2) before the text, as fairseq's language model puts its eos before the sequence (src/language_model_prompt_dataset.py, collate, move_eos_to_beginning)
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.fairseq_preprocessing: Moses tokenizer.perl -l en -a (aggressive hyphen splitting, escaping on), fastBPE with biogpt_large_bpecodes, and fairseq-preprocess with biogpt_large_dict.txt (examples/QA-PubMedQA/preprocess_large.sh); the tokenizer at the revision stands in for these, and step 4 checks it on made-up text
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.setting: reasoning-required: the question and the contexts, without the long answer
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.source: 'question: {q} context: {c} ', where q is the question stripped and c is the contexts, each stripped, joined with single spaces, with newlines replaced by spaces, runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, and stripped (examples/QA-PubMedQA/rebuild_data.py, build_source_seq without long_answer)

learned_prompt.basis: the model's vocabulary (57,726 entries) adds learned1 to learned9 (ids 57717 to 57725) after BioGPT-Large's 57,717 (microsoft/biogpt-large's vocab.json); the task adds one dictionary entry for each learned token (src/language_modeling_prompt.py, setup_prompt: encode_line adds missing words)

biogpt_large_pubmedqa.order: source tokens (without their eos), then learned1 to learned9, then the target (collate's make_sentence with prefix False: torch.cat([source, prompt, target])); the task adds <seqsep> to the dictionary only when prefix is True (setup_prompt), and the vocabulary has no <seqsep>
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.target: the answer to the question given the context is {yes|no|maybe}. (rebuild_data.py, build_target_seq)
biogpt_large_pubmedqa.target_opening_words: the answer to the question given the context is

source_truncation.rule: a source longer than 384 tokens keeps its first 383 and '...' (id 11774), as LanguageModelPromptDataset.__getitem__ cuts it
source_truncation.basis: the task's default (src/language_modeling_prompt.py); the fine-tuning command is not in the repository at this commit, and the checkpoint's own arguments could not be read (correction 5)

checkpoint_arguments.status: not read in step 0: the archive's host is outside the network allowlists of the linked shell and the cloud workspace
checkpoint_arguments.archive: https://msralaphilly2.blob.core.windows.net/release/BioGPT/checkpoints/QA-PubMedQA-BioGPT-Large.tgz (with the read-only signature in microsoft/BioGPT's README at the commit)
checkpoint_arguments.rule: correction 5: the pod reads them before scoring and uses them if they differ

biogpt_large_pubmedqa.published_inference: infer_large.sh runs inference.py (beam 1, generation); postprocess.py takes the words after 'the answer to the question given the context is', and hard_match_evaluation.py scores accuracy; this project reads the next token's probabilities after the opening words instead (PUBMEDQA BESIDE BIOGPT-LARGE)

gemma_4_31b_it.thinking_off: apply_chat_template(messages, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False) with no system message; the template's default for enable_thinking is false, and with it off the generation prompt ends with an empty thought block, '<|channel>thought\n<channel|>', so the next token is the answer (model card, section 'Thinking Mode Configuration': 'if thinking is disabled, the model will still generate the tags but with an empty thought block')

vllm.gemma_4: supported; the 0.30.0 release notes list Gemma 4 work (QKV fuser for Gemma4, #55690; pruned sliding-window tiles for Gemma 4 multimodal prompts, #53147)

builds.default: vllm==0.30.0 from PyPI, built for CUDA 13.0 (the release's default)

vllm.rule_on_the_pod: prepare_large reads the driver's CUDA version from nvidia-smi: 13.0 or later, the default build; otherwise the cu129 build; then checks that vLLM imports and CUDA starts in /root/eddm_s8/vllm_env/ (correction 1)

python_packages: the versions in uv.lock where it lists them (transformers 5.17.0); tabicl and sacremoses as above, tabicl in its own environment (/root/eddm_s9/tabicl_env/)
